newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Ansett says is reviewing jet fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Ansett says is reviewing jet fuel surcharge.

text.p: Australian air carrier Ansett Airways said on Wednesday it is reviewing the possibility of a jet fuel surcharge on its international freight rates in light of the rise in the jet fuel price.

"We are reviewing the situation due to the rise in the price of fuel and we will be making a decision on whether or not it will impact our fares at some point in the future," Ansett public affairs officer Geoff Lynch told Reuters.
Earlier fellow Australian carrier Qantas Airways Ltd said it would impose a jet fuel surcharge from November 18 in relation to higher fuel prices.
Ansett is jointly owned by News Corp Ltd and Air New Zealand Ltd.
